# The Theory of Becoming

<!-- Generated by tools/research/research.py render. Edit records or scoped goals, not this view. -->

[Home](../../README.md) · [Results](../../RESULTS.md) · [Scopes](../../GOALS.md) · [Connections](../../DEPENDENCIES.md) · [Contribute](../../_process/RESULT-WORKFLOW.md)

Canonical entry: [The Theory of Becoming](chapters/THE-THEORY-OF-BECOMING.md), with its premise card, eight parts, formal spine and the place of earlier chapters.

We investigate how relations form, persist and change within one unfolding of becoming, and how organization, living, knowing, learning, evaluation and wisdom differentiate within it. Real losses, distinct scopes and counterexamples remain explicit; success in a local model does not by itself establish a universal warrant.

Read [the shared method](chapters/NONDUAL-METHOD.md) before foundational work. [Working rules](../../AGENTS.md) apply throughout; the scope directory preserves independently authorized goals.

| Location | Responsibility |

| `theories/` | Current argument and interpretation |
